<!--
  FATHERS FRONT - SHARED PORTAL BASE CODE

  Install on every Fathers Front Systeme.io page.
  Contains embedded fonts and shared header/menu/footer styling.
  Does not contain checkout-page or product-page component overrides.
-->
<link rel="icon" href="https://fathersfront.com/favicon.svg" type="image/svg+xml">
<link rel="icon" href="https://fathersfront.com/favicon-32x32.png" type="image/png" sizes="32x32">
<link rel="apple-touch-icon" href="https://fathersfront.com/apple-touch-icon.png" sizes="180x180">

<style>
/* ==========================================================================
   SHARED PORTAL BASE
   Header/menu, footer, embedded fonts, responsive navigation, and global reset.
   ========================================================================== */
@font-face {
  font-family: "FF Barlow Condensed";
  src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format("woff2");
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 600;
  font-display: swap;
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "FF Libre Franklin";
  src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,") format("woff2");
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 400 600;
  font-display: swap;
}

@font-face {
  font-family: "FF Tungsten Condensed";
  src: url("data:font/ttf;base64,") format("truetype");
  font-style: normal;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-display: swap;
}
:root {
  --ff-ink: #171412;
  --ff-cream: #f4ecdc;
  --ff-oxblood: #912d2f;
  --ff-ember: #e84509;
  --ff-line: rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.22);
}

html,
body {
  margin: 0 !important;
  padding: 0 !important;
}

.ff-sio-header,
.ff-sio-header *,
.ff-sio-footer,
.ff-sio-footer * {
  box-sizing: border-box;
}

.ff-sio-header {
  position: sticky;
  top: 0;
  z-index: 10000;
  width: 100%;
  height: 126px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  background: rgba(13, 11, 10, 0.94);
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(233, 222, 200, 0.18);
  backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(12px);
}

.ff-sio-header a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ff-sio-header__inner {
  width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 48px));
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0 auto;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 34px;
}

.ff-sio-header__brand {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 0.16em;
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  color: #e9dec8;
  font: 700 60px/0.9 "FF Tungsten Condensed", "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.035em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ff-sio-header__brand-front {
  color: var(--ff-oxblood);
}

.ff-sio-header__nav {
  height: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 34px;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  font: 600 28px/1 "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ff-sio-header__nav > a {
  position: relative;
  padding: 49px 0;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ff-sio-header__nav > a::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 100%;
  bottom: 34px;
  left: 0;
  height: 2px;
  content: "";
  background: var(--ff-ember);
  transition: right 180ms ease;
}

.ff-sio-header__nav > a:hover::after,
.ff-sio-header__nav > a:focus-visible::after {
  right: 0;
}

.ff-sio-header__dropdown {
  position: relative;
  z-index: 5;
  height: 100%;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
}

.ff-sio-header__dropdown-label {
  position: relative;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::after {
  margin-left: 0.35em;
  color: var(--ff-oxblood);
  content: "+";
}

.ff-sio-header__submenu {
  position: absolute;
  top: calc(50% + 18px);
  left: 0;
  z-index: 5;
  width: 250px;
  padding: 8px 0;
  display: grid;
  gap: 0;
  background: #11100f;
  box-shadow: 0 24px 55px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.72);
  opacity: 0;
  visibility: hidden;
  transform: translateY(8px);
  text-align: left;
  transition: opacity 180ms ease, transform 180ms ease, visibility 180ms ease;
}

.ff-sio-header__submenu a {
  position: relative;
  padding: 14px 20px 12px;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  font: 600 28px/1 "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ff-sio-header__submenu a::after {
  position: absolute;
  right: 100%;
  bottom: 8px;
  left: 20px;
  height: 2px;
  content: "";
  background: var(--ff-ember);
  transition: right 180ms ease;
}

.ff-sio-header__submenu a:hover::after,
.ff-sio-header__submenu a:focus-visible::after {
  right: 20px;
}

.ff-sio-header__dropdown:hover .ff-sio-header__submenu,
.ff-sio-header__dropdown:focus-within .ff-sio-header__submenu {
  opacity: 1;
  visibility: visible;
  transform: translateY(0);
}

.ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta {
  padding: 15px 18px;
  border: 2px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
  transition: color 180ms ease, background 180ms ease, border-color 180ms ease;
}

.ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta::after {
  display: none;
}

.ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta:hover,
.ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta:focus-visible {
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  background: rgba(145, 45, 47, 0.16);
  border-color: var(--ff-ember);
}

.ff-sio-header__version {
  margin-left: 0;
  color: #8e8579;
  font: 600 10px "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.14em;
  white-space: nowrap;
}

.ff-sio-header__toggle,
.ff-sio-header__mobile-heading {
  display: none;
}

.ff-sio-footer {
  width: 100%;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 80px 0 35px;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  background: #0c0a09;
  border-top: 1px solid var(--ff-line);
  font: 400 16px/1.5 "FF Libre Franklin", Arial, sans-serif;
}

.ff-sio-footer a {
  color: inherit;
  text-decoration: none;
}

.ff-sio-footer__shell {
  width: min(1180px, calc(100% - 48px));
  margin: 0 auto;
}

.ff-sio-footer__grid {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.6fr) minmax(130px, 0.7fr) minmax(160px, 0.8fr);
  gap: 60px;
}

.ff-sio-footer__dispatch {
  min-width: 0;
  text-align: left;
}

.ff-sio-footer__kicker {
  margin: 0 0 12px;
  color: #8d8378;
  font: 600 11px "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.18em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ff-sio-footer__title {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Arial, sans-serif;
  font-size: 42px;
  font-weight: 900;
  line-height: 1.5;
  letter-spacing: -0.025em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ff-sio-footer__description {
  max-width: 560px;
  margin: 12px 0 22px;
  color: #a99f92;
  font-size: 14px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  text-align: left;
}

.ff-sio-footer__form {
  max-width: 580px;
  margin: 0;
  display: flex;
  align-items: stretch;
  gap: 10px;
  text-align: left;
}

.ff-sio-footer__form input {
  min-width: 0;
  flex: 1 1 auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 15px 16px;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  background: #100e0d;
  border: 1px solid #675d53;
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  font: 500 14px "FF Libre Franklin", Arial, sans-serif;
}

.ff-sio-footer__form input::placeholder {
  color: #8d8378;
}

.ff-sio-footer__form input:focus {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ff-cream);
  outline-offset: 2px;
}

.ff-sio-footer__form button {
  flex: 0 0 auto;
  margin: 0;
  padding: 0 18px;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  background: transparent;
  border: 2px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
  border-radius: 0;
  box-shadow: none;
  cursor: pointer;
  font: 600 12px "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.1em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  white-space: nowrap;
  transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
}

.ff-sio-footer__form button:hover,
.ff-sio-footer__form button:focus-visible {
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  background: rgba(145, 45, 47, 0.16);
  border-color: var(--ff-ember);
}

.ff-sio-footer__links {
  display: grid;
  align-content: start;
  justify-items: start;
  gap: 15px;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  font: 600 15px "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ff-sio-footer__links a {
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  text-align: left;
}

.ff-sio-footer__links a:hover,
.ff-sio-footer__links a:focus-visible {
  color: var(--ff-cream);
}

.ff-sio-footer__note {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: flex-start;
  color: #8d8378;
  text-align: left;
}

.ff-sio-footer__pillars {
  margin: 0;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  font: 600 20px/1.15 "FF Barlow Condensed", Impact, sans-serif;
  letter-spacing: 0.12em;
  text-align: left;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.ff-sio-footer__pillars i {
  color: var(--ff-oxblood);
  font-style: normal;
}

.ff-sio-footer__social {
  margin: 28px 0;
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  justify-content: flex-start;
}

.ff-sio-footer__social a {
  width: 42px;
  height: 42px;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  color: var(--ff-cream);
  border: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.25);
  transition: color 160ms ease, background 160ms ease, border-color 160ms ease;
}

.ff-sio-footer__social a:hover,
.ff-sio-footer__social a:focus-visible {
  color: #fff;
  background: var(--ff-oxblood);
  border-color: var(--ff-oxblood);
}

.ff-sio-footer__social svg {
  width: 19px;
  height: 19px;
  display: block;
  fill: none;
  stroke: currentColor;
  stroke-width: 1.8;
}

.ff-sio-footer__social .ff-sio-footer__social-fill {
  fill: currentColor;
  stroke: none;
}

.ff-sio-footer__legal {
  margin: 0;
  color: #8d8378;
  font-size: 16px;
  line-height: 1.5;
  text-align: left;
}

.ff-sio-footer__sr-only {
  position: absolute;
  width: 1px;
  height: 1px;
  padding: 0;
  margin: -1px;
  overflow: hidden;
  clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);
  white-space: nowrap;
  border: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 980px) {
  #app section:has(.ff-sio-header),
  #app section:has(.ff-sio-footer),
  #app [id^="row-"]:has(.ff-sio-header),
  #app [id^="row-"]:has(.ff-sio-footer) {
    margin: 0 !important;
    padding: 0 !important;
  }

  #app [id^="rawhtml-"]:has(.ff-sio-header) {
    height: 0 !important;
    min-height: 0 !important;
  }

  .ff-sio-header {
    height: 0;
    border: 0;
    background: transparent;
    backdrop-filter: none;
    -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__inner {
    width: 100%;
    height: 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__brand,
  .ff-sio-header__version {
    display: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__toggle {
    position: fixed;
    top: 14px;
    right: 15px;
    z-index: 2147483647;
    width: 48px;
    height: 48px;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 0;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    gap: 5px;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: #0d0b0a;
    border: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.28);
    border-radius: 0;
    cursor: pointer;
    pointer-events: auto;
    touch-action: manipulation;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__toggle span {
    width: 24px;
    height: 2px;
    display: block;
    background: currentColor;
    transition: transform 180ms ease, opacity 180ms ease;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(1) {
    transform: translateY(7px) rotate(45deg);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(2) {
    opacity: 0;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__toggle[aria-expanded="true"] span:nth-child(3) {
    transform: translateY(-7px) rotate(-45deg);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav {
    position: fixed;
    inset: 0;
    z-index: 2147483646;
    min-height: 100svh;
    max-height: 100svh;
    margin: 0;
    padding: 96px 24px 32px;
    display: none;
    overflow-y: auto;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    gap: 0;
    color: var(--ff-cream);
    background: var(--ff-ink);
    font-size: 28px;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav.is-open {
    display: flex;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__mobile-heading {
    width: 100%;
    margin: 0 0 8px;
    padding: 0 0 18px;
    display: flex;
    align-items: baseline;
    justify-content: space-between;
    color: #e9dec8;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.28);
    font-size: 13px;
    letter-spacing: 0.16em;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__mobile-heading b {
    color: #a99f92;
    font-size: 10px;
    font-weight: 600;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > a {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 58px;
    padding: 14px 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.14);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > a::after,
  .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__dropdown {
    width: 100%;
    height: auto;
    display: block;
    border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(244, 236, 220, 0.14);
  }

  .ff-sio-header__dropdown-label {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 17px 0 10px;
    display: block;
    text-align: left !important;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu {
    position: static;
    width: auto;
    padding: 0 0 14px 18px;
    display: grid;
    opacity: 1;
    visibility: visible;
    transform: none;
    background: transparent;
    border: 0;
    box-shadow: none;
    text-align: left !important;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu a {
    padding: 8px 0 8px 15px;
    color: #a99f92;
    border-left: 1px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
    font-size: 16px;
    line-height: 1;
    text-align: left !important;
    white-space: normal;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__submenu a::after {
    display: none;
  }

  .ff-sio-header__nav > .ff-sio-header__cta {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 58px;
    margin-top: 24px;
    padding: 14px 18px;
    justify-content: center;
    border: 1px solid var(--ff-oxblood);
  }

  .ff-sio-footer {
    padding: 64px 0 30px;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__shell {
    width: min(100% - 36px, 1180px);
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__grid {
    grid-template-columns: 1fr;
    gap: 48px;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__title {
    font-size: clamp(36px, 10vw, 46px);
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__note {
    display: block;
  }
}

@media (max-width: 560px) {
  .ff-sio-footer__form {
    flex-direction: column;
  }

  .ff-sio-footer__form button {
    width: 100%;
    min-height: 50px;
  }
}

</style>
